meta.title: Introduction to the Solar System
meta.subject: Science
meta.description: Learn the basic facts about our Solar System, its planets, and a short quiz.

notes: The Solar System consists of the Sun and everything bound to it by gravity.
There are eight planets: Mercury, Venus, Earth, Mars, Jupiter, Saturn, Uranus, and Neptune.
The asteroid belt lies between Mars and Jupiter.
Earth is the only planet known to support life.

flashcards.front: How many planets are in the Solar System?
Which planet is known as the Red Planet?
What lies between Mars and Jupiter?
Which planet has the most moons?

quiz.q: Which planet is closest to the Sun?
quiz.explanation: Mercury is the smallest and closest planet to the Sun.

quiz.q: What planet is known for its rings?
quiz.explanation: Saturn has a prominent system of rings made of ice and rock.

quiz.q: Which planet is farthest from the Sun?
quiz.explanation: Neptune is the eighth and farthest known planet from the Sun.
